name: Beer
overview: The topic of Beer in Scripture includes both the literal places named Beer, such as a well and towns within Israelite territory, and the caution regarding strong drink in worship contexts. Numbers 21 recounts the journey of Israel to Beer, a significant well where God promised water, highlighting His provision for His people. Judges 9:21 references Beer as a refuge, showing its role as a place of safety. Leviticus 10:9 instructs the priests to abstain from wine and strong drink when entering the tabernacle, emphasizing holiness and sobriety in approaching God.
